## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(CAISOPEA)
library(duckdb)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
con <- duckdb::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())

# Keep RTM data as a lazy DuckDB table — never collected into R memory.
# DuckDB reads directly from the parquet file and pushes all filters/aggregations
# down to the scan, so only the final small result tables come into R.
rtm_data <- dplyr::tbl(
  con,
  dplyr::sql(
    "SELECT MARKETPRODUCTTYPE, RESOURCEBID_SEQ, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA,
            SCH_BID_TIMEINTERVALSTART, SCH_BID_TIMEINTERVALSTOP,
            TIMEINTERVALSTART, TIMEINTERVALEND
     FROM read_parquet('CAISO_rtm_big.parquet')
     WHERE MARKETPRODUCTTYPE = 'EN' AND RESOURCEBID_SEQ IS NOT NULL"
  )
)

outages <- arrow::read_parquet(
  here("prior_trade_day_outages.parquet"),
  as_data_frame = FALSE
)
```

## Run Matching

```{r}
#| label: run-matching
#| message: false
rtm_results <- get_outage_rtm_matches(
  rtm_data = rtm_data,
  outages = outages,
  generators = NULL,
  edge_minutes = 5,
  min_matches = 1L,
  resolve_collisions = TRUE,
  top_n = 5L,
  return_detail = TRUE
)

cat(
  "Final unique matches (collision-resolved): ",
  nrow(rtm_results$final_matches),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Top-candidate rows (up to 5 per generator):",
  nrow(rtm_results$top_candidates),
  "\n"
)
```

## Final Matches

One row per named generator — best seq ID after collision resolution.

```{r}
#| label: final-matches
rtm_results$final_matches
```

## Top Candidates (up to 5 per generator)

Up to 5 candidate seq IDs per generator, ranked by score with no collision
resolution applied.

```{r}
#| label: top-candidates
rtm_results$top_candidates
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-confidence
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
plot_data <- rtm_results$final_matches |>
  filter(is.finite(confidence), confidence < 1)

n_unambiguous <- sum(rtm_results$final_matches$confidence == 1)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = 1 / (1 - confidence))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2.2,
    y = Inf,
    label = "ratio > 2  (confidence \u2265 0.5)",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1.5,
    color = "firebrick",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = paste0(n_unambiguous, " unambiguous matches\n(confidence = 1.0)"),
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3.5,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Raw Confidence Ratios (log scale)",
    subtitle = "Excludes unambiguous matches (confidence = 1.0)",
    x = "Raw Score Ratio (log scale)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Export

```{r}
#| label: export
#| message: false
dir.create(here("final_outputs"), showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  rtm_results$final_matches,
  here("final_outputs", "outage_rtm_matches_final.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  rtm_results$top_candidates,
  here("final_outputs", "outage_rtm_top_candidates.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  rtm_results$match_detail,
  here("final_outputs", "outage_rtm_match_detail.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Total outage windows per generator vs how many matched
write.csv(
  rtm_results$outages |>
    dplyr::count(
      generator,
      name = "total_outage_events"
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      rtm_results$final_matches |>
        dplyr::select(
          generator,
          generator_name,
          RESOURCEBID_SEQ,
          n_matches,
          pmax_mw,
          max_mw,
          confidence,
          score
        ),
      by = "generator"
    ),
  here("final_outputs", "outage_rtm_event_counts.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "Wrote final_outputs/outage_rtm_matches_final.csv    —",
  nrow(rtm_results$final_matches),
  "rows\n"
)
cat(
  "Wrote final_outputs/outage_rtm_top_candidates.csv   —",
  nrow(rtm_results$top_candidates),
  "rows\n"
)
cat(
  "Wrote final_outputs/outage_rtm_match_detail.csv     —",
  nrow(rtm_results$match_detail),
  "rows\n"
)
```
